github.name: GitHub
github.intro: Start Goal tasks from Issue and PR comments that @mention a bot account; results are posted as comments.
github.botLoginHelp: The GitHub login that owns the token, for example kcoder-bot. Only comments that @mention this account start tasks.
github.repositoriesHelp: One owner/name per line or separated by commas, up to {{max}}.
github.pollIntervalHelp: {{min}}–{{max}} seconds. Leave blank for the default {{defaultSeconds}} seconds.
github.behavior: KCoder polls these repositories, so new comments arrive after up to one polling interval (60 seconds by default). Each Issue or PR comment that @mentions the bot starts a Goal task, the result is posted as a comment on the same Issue or PR, and a later @mention there continues that task. Comments from bots and CI are ignored.
github.tokenHelp: Then authorize with a fine-grained personal access token of the bot account that has Issues read and write access to these repositories. The token is stored privately on the target, never in these settings.
github.unavailable: This target does not provide the GitHub source yet. Update the target, then refresh.

errors.botLoginInvalid: Use a GitHub login such as kcoder-bot, without spaces.
errors.pollIntervalInvalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{maxSeconds}}.

github.taskBindingUnsupported: GitHub sources do not support this task-binding flow. Manage the source and repository scope in connection settings.
